name: pi-btw
notes:
Local divergence: extensions/btw.ts migrates the hand-written transcript state machine (~200 lines) to the shared @xzzpig/pi-components builder API (appendEntry/ensureTurn/finishTurn/findLatestEntry/ensureToolCall/upsertText/upsertToolResult/removeTranscriptTurn/hasStreamingTranscriptEntry); entry/state types now alias the library's TranscriptEntry/TranscriptState. Behavior-equivalent (58/58 tests match pre-migration baseline). @xzzpig/pi-components is bundled via bundledDependencies (private, never published to npm); the pin tracks the bundled workspace version and is 0.4.0 since that release added appendText/appendAssistantMessage and TranscriptRenderOptions.hideThinkingBlock (btw keeps its upsertText usage and the expanded default, so no btw source change was needed). Intentional local-only change; upstream has no dependency on @xzzpig/pi-components. v0.5.0 sync: fork keeps the pi-components migration on top of the upstream rewrite; upstream's own overlay renderer (buildOverlayTranscript + per-entry helpers) was NOT adopted, rendering stays on pi-components renderTranscriptLines (markdown-aware). Turn outcomes (completed/aborted/failed) were added as an optional `outcome` field on turn-boundary entries in @xzzpig/pi-components (TranscriptTurnOutcome; finishTurn third parameter); upstream's markdownTheme/managesMouseReporting/rebuildTranscriptLines additions were dropped with the self-implemented renderer, and SGR mouse-reporting + fork's ownsMouseReporting field remain fork-only. Re-apply the migration/outcome threading on each future sync. 2026-09-19 cleanup: package-lock.json deleted (stale — pinned pi-components 0.3.0 vs required 0.4.0 — and unparseable by npm because devDeps use catalog:; pnpm never reads it; delete again if a future subtree pull resurrects it); dead removeTranscriptTurn import removed; 'skills' dropped from package.json files (skill deregistered since 0.7.1; the directory stays to avoid subtree delete conflicts).
v0.6.1 sync (2026-09-25, fork 0.9.0): adopted upstream /btw:ask enforced read-only mode (BTW_TOOLS_BY_MODE), /side alias, and the Pi 0.87 SessionManager seeding fix; extensions/btw.ts auto-merged with the fork's pi-components migration and [BTW SESSION BOUNDARY] marker intact. Recurring-cost notes for future syncs: (1) upstream tests asserting the upstream renderer's 'You  <text>' user-row badge format must be re-adapted to plain-text assertions (fork renderer has no You label) — done this sync for the /btw:ask persistence and in-modal tests; (2) upstream tests asserting SessionManager.appendMessage call counts need +1 because the fork's boundary message is also seeded; (3) package-lock.json deleted again after resurrection; (4) pi-ai added to devDeps as explicit 0.83.0 (no catalog entry exists; matches pi-components precedent), peerDependencies already carry >=0.83.0 <1; (5) known environment-dependent failure, NOT code: 'applies distinct theme treatment' asserts truecolor ANSI and fails when COLORTERM is unset — run suites with COLORTERM=truecolor.
